commands:
set -eu
aws s3 cp s3://fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/source/parallel-v1.zip /tmp/parallel-v1.zip --region ap-southeast-2
echo '9cfdc3f51890ddd7b6845db538c62bfe689a66b1cb37c58614f21e290bc9c9cc  /tmp/parallel-v1.zip' | sha256sum -c -
mkdir /opt/fyp-phase82-parallel-v1
unzip -q /tmp/parallel-v1.zip -d /opt/fyp-phase82-parallel-v1
chown -R fyp:fyp /opt/fyp-phase82-parallel-v1
aws s3 cp s3://fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/source/finish-v1.sh /tmp/finish-v1.sh --region ap-southeast-2
echo '179d4d2985317ce2a676f7430985e0a07bb1c2322d3d4479dab84794f5e4d8d9  /tmp/finish-v1.sh' | sha256sum -c -
sed 's/\r$//' /tmp/finish-v1.sh | sed 's/@BUCKET@/fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/g' >/opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/finish-v1-lf.sh
bash -n /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/finish-v1-lf.sh
cat >/etc/systemd/system/fyp-p82-finish.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Finite AWS calibration export and stop, main blocked
After=docker.service network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/bash /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/finish-v1-lf.sh
TimeoutStartSec=80min
KillMode=process
Restart=no
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl start --no-block fyp-p82-finish.service
systemctl show fyp-p82-finish.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID
systemctl show fyp-p82-qualification.service -p ActiveState -p Result
